questions: Can a participant reproduce the author method on the original retinal endpoint?
Can a participant improve that endpoint relative to a fresh same-split author reference under a supported precommitted assessment policy?

endpoint.target: Dendritic calcium prediction from checkerboard stimulation using the supplied transient Off-alpha retinal ganglion-cell morphology.
endpoint.figure: Final published Figure 3; author directory nex/fig4_rgc.
endpoint.scope: Held-out field-by-frame observations within the same cell under frozen preprocessing. No demonstrated new-stimulus, new-field, cross-cell or animal-population generalization.
endpoint.replication: Fields, ROIs, merged sites, repeated stimulus frames and fitting seeds do not create independent biological cells.

fresh_source_default_split.row_identity: field_index * 1024 + stimulus_frame_index; bind the exact source index convention.
fresh_source_default_split.method: RandomState(seed_membrane + seed_ruler).permutation over field-by-frame rows; test prefix, then training, then validation; validation fraction 0.2 of non-test rows with source rounding.
fresh_source_default_split.caveat: The loader repeats the same 1024-frame sequence across fields. Row-level partitioning is not stimulus-identity grouping.
fresh_source_default_split.required_binding: Exact ordered identities, permutation/configuration, randomization, ROI/site/field lineage and masks; counts alone are insufficient.

preprocessing.scope: Whole cropped recordings before downstream split.
operations: Per-ROI z-scoring over the cropped recording.
Delay selection with five-fold negative-MAE fits across all 232 ROI traces before holdout.
Branch/bin mapping and mean aggregation into 147 sites.
preprocessing.caveat: Not train-only preprocessing. Preserve and disclose the exact same method and realization for author and candidate.
preprocessing.required_binding: Input lineage, crop, transform implementation/configuration, delay, ROI-to-site/field mapping and resulting split/mask realization.

common_materials: Same approved stimuli, morphology, identities and training calcium.
Same explicitly approved validation-target access if available.
Same structural masks, preprocessing, split, compute/access policy and scoring support.
conditions.validation_access: The new logical candidate_view_v2 returns detached TRAIN and VAL targets equally for A/B and excludes TEST targets. Its v1 predecessor supplied TRAIN targets only. Bind the exact approved validation material and enforce equal exposure: a detached view does not authenticate approval or physically restrict files, tools or later access. Missing approval, material provenance or enforcement prevents qualification.
conditions.masks: Common or derivable from exposed field, row and site identities. The evaluator owns the authoritative scoring mask; participants cannot choose support.
private: Final test-score feedback before freezing and assessment.
Trusted reference/evaluator artifacts not approved for participant exposure.
conditions.physical_transport: UNBOUND. Descriptive pins, allowlists and readiness fields are not an enforcing transport or authenticated event provenance.
conditions.feedback_limit: No candidate 21-query limit is asserted: 21 is the author fit validation-check count, not an enforced limit with visible validation targets.
conditions.manifest_limit: Candidate-manifest descriptors are metadata, not the actual array payload or proof of delivered access. A/B share the paper and morphology; B author_code must match the pinned author-reference source snapshot.

freeze_before_test: Immutable executable programme and permitted information.
Optimization recipe, randomization and matched compute/access budget.
Actual validation-selected checkpoint and executed provenance.
programme_and_reference.fresh_reference: Execute the pinned author method on the exact same split, all sites, authoritative masks and preprocessing under the precommitted matched resource policy; bind its selected checkpoint, predictions and executed provenance.

source_fit_context.applies_to: Frozen author-reference defaults only; candidate recipes are separately frozen under the matched policy and need not use these epoch or batch counts.

programme_and_reference.not_supplied: No full-fit reference, candidate endpoint prediction or benchmark outcome is created by this source contribution.
programme_and_reference.compute_context_caveat: The prepared reference route omits receptive-field plots, the epoch-start/final diagnostic checkpoint stream, and train/test monitoring passes with test-scalar logging. These diagnostics did not select parameters, but their omission changes run cost and must be explicit in the matched-compute policy. Retained endpoint mathematics and 21 validation checks do not establish complete historical-run equivalence.

scoring.metric: Per-site Pearson correlation on the evaluator mask, then arithmetic mean across all 147 sites.
scoring.preservation: Unchanged scorer, strict admission and undefined-site behavior. No pooled samples, support weighting, dropped sites or replacement by training loss or numerical model equivalence.
scoring.descriptive_output: Complete unchanged legacy comparison, including author/candidate scores and paired delta.

published_context.role: Rounded context only; not a fresh-split pass threshold.

assessment.entrypoint: assess_pair(operator, author, candidate, *, episode, trusted_operator_evidence=None, policy_precommit=None)
policy_requirements: Supported temporal, field, site and repeated-stimulus dependence treatment.
Justified meaningful effect and uncertainty, or a justified policy explicitly declining unsupported inference.
Authenticated policy authority and commitment chronology before candidate/test evaluation.
assessment.policy_metadata_limit: Artifact/receipt pins and an event identifier are descriptive. No policy evaluator, authority/chronology verifier or physical-transport verifier is bound here.
assessment.rule: This source version cannot qualify reproduction or improvement. Scores/deltas do not replace paired execution, physical transport or supported precommitted scientific assessment. No IID 147-site bootstrap or post-hoc rule is selected.

legacy_boundary.preservation: Strict historical admission, source-control uncertainty and unresolved legacy pairing remain unchanged. A fresh same-split result cannot establish historical score reproduction, separate seven-field Figure 3f success, full-36 programme success or current SOTA.
legacy_boundary.role: The three task-root files listed here are immutable historical bindings. They remain preserved when the separate versioned correction is explicitly adopted.

remaining_work: Physically enforcing A/B material transport with equal approved validation access and authenticated exposure/event provenance.
Complete full-fit singleton integration preserving the original scientific loop, normalization and tolerances.
Actual fresh-author/candidate execution and immutable programme, validation-selection and checkpoint provenance under matched compute.
Supported precommitted scientific policy with authority, chronology and evaluator binding.
execution_selection: None. No full256, fullfit, reference, candidate, model, data-body or native execution is authorized or claimed by this contract.

active_correction.maintained_projection: The maintained task-specific binder supports explicit --adopt-retinal-paired-correction adoption after authenticating the exact task, paired component, descriptor and corrected content. The ordinary subsequent pass preserves the adopted active projection; there is no generic override or fallback.
active_correction.historical_preservation: Adoption selects these separate versioned active contracts; it does not overwrite the three task-root historical contracts or weaken preserved registry fields.
active_correction.scientific_status: UNQUALIFIED. Maintained contract adoption is not scientific policy authorization, physical-transport qualification, completed execution, reproduction or improvement.
